# Restricted Permutations

**Time Limit:** `1000 ms`  
**Memory Limit:** `128 MB`  
**Source:** [https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/restricted-permutations/](https://csacademy.com/contest/archive/task/restricted-permutations/)  

---

Find the number of permutations of size $N$, where for each $i$, $1 \leq i < N$, you know whether $i$ comes before or after $i+1$.

### Standard input

The first line contains a single integer $N$.

The second line contains a binary array of size $N-1$. The $i^{th}$ element of this array is $1$ if $i$ comes before $i+1$ in the permutation, $0$ otherwise.

### Standard output

Print the answer modulo $10^9+7$ on the first line.

### Constraints and notes

$2 \leq N \leq 2000$
